bind_address.description: Network interface IP address to bind control and media ports (e.g., '127.0.0.1', '0.0.0.0'). Use 0.0.0.0 only in trusted networks.

rtp_port.description: UDP port for RTP voice/data frames (L1 ↔ L2 interface). Must match BTS (e.g., osmo-bts-trx) configuration.

control_port.description: UDP port for OsmoTRX control protocol (used by osmo-bts-trx to manage transceiver).

instance_name.description: Logical name for this TRX instance (e.g., 'trx0', 'trx1'). Must be unique per host and match BTS config.

max_trx.description: Maximum number of TRX instances this transceiver can support (e.g., 1 for single-carrier, 3 for 3-sector BTS).

limesdr_serial.description: LimeSDR device serial number (optional; leave blank to auto-detect).

limesdr_tx_gain.description: LimeSDR transmit gain (0–73 dB). Start with ~60 and adjust for signal strength.

limesdr_rx_gain.description: LimeSDR receive gain (0–73 dB). Adjust to avoid saturation while maintaining good SNR.

limesdr_tx_freq_offset.description: LimeSDR TX frequency correction in kHz (used for calibration against reference oscillator).

limesdr_rx_freq_offset.description: LimeSDR RX frequency correction in kHz.

usrp_subdev.description: USRP subdevice specification (e.g., 'A:0' for main A port).

hackrf_device_index.description: HackRF device index (0 for first device, 1 for second, etc.).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logs: 0=none, 1=error, 2=warning, 3=info, 4=debug, 5=trace. 3 is recommended for production.

loopback.description: Enable internal RF loopback (TX → RX) for self-testing. Disable for normal operation.

clock_source.description: Timing reference source: 'internal' (board oscillator), 'external' (10 MHz input), or 'gpsdo' (GPS-disciplined oscillator).
